literal: Cruel person / than cruelty / themselves / cruel / these days / long / passing / nights
translation: The long, dragging nights of these days are themselves more cruel than the cruelty of the cruel one.
modern: கொடியவரான காதலரின் கொடுமையை விட, இப்போது நீண்டுகொண்டே போகும் இந்த இரவுகள் மிகவும் கொடியவையாக இருக்கின்றன.
explanation: The speaker laments the unbearable length of the nights while separated from her lover. She calls her lover cruel for leaving her alone to suffer. However, she feels that the nights that drag on endlessly these days are even more cruel than his abandonment. The repetition of the word cruel emphasizes how the agonizingly slow passage of time in the dark multiplies her sorrow.
